decisionScope: Qualified read-only screen; advance only1,0:v to disposable actual-owner staging, not product adoption
corrections: Latest builder correctly calls four corner-node combinations rather than proven closed road blocks.
Latest builder distinguishes reported full totals/geometric aggregates from independently reconstructible retained results.
Latest builder correctly identifies displayed grade as rounded endpoint rise/run.
Candidate selection is editorial prioritization:1,0:v is ranked12/23 per seed and second of three common proxy-safe options; lower displayed grade does not imply lower maximum sampled slope.
limitations: Only100 ranked candidates per seed are retained. The281/318 filtered totals and268/280 grid-node totals are reported metadata, not independently reconstructible from an absent complete node/edge/cell map or untruncated candidate list.

All four corner nodes are required, but the screen checks only two nearby straight distinct endpoint edges within8m. It does not prove a closed block, identify all crossings or validate service/landmark/building footprints.

Cell ranking uses currently painted, unclaimed cell centers7–34m from the segment at8–92% along it. Core and endpoint contact are conservative proxies, not emitted frontage, full footprints or lost parcels. Raw cell keys and terrain sample arrays are not retained, so only their aggregate arithmetic is recomputed.

Water is sampled21 times along a line; maximum terrain slope is recorded but not penalized in rank. Public evaluator uses its own2m sampling, mean endpoint grade, cut/water/bounds/angle/funds checks. Neither a zero water count nor lower mean grade establishes an easier earthworks profile.

Rank weights4/−8/−2/−20 and safe threshold core0/endpoints<=3 are heuristics. The three safe common candidates are not universally safe or the only promising designs.41common covers separate rank-truncated sets only.

Magnet snaps prioritize nodes within12m and then edges within10m; prefilter radius is8m. Many candidates snap existing midpoint nodes rather than split edges. All retained coordinates match proposed endpoints, and every recorded edge snap matches its prefilter edge ID; this does not generalize beyond retained records.
Public validity is preview validity only. No commit, actual edge split, payment, regeneration, owner allocation, service/transit response, undo/redo or save/load is tested.

Count equality plus the inspected no-commit tool path supports no intended structural world mutation, not bit-identical payloads, finance, services or terrain. Public drafts and the diagnostic global are temporary runtime changes; caches/preview state may change.

No before/after renderer identity, source-response byte manifest, screenshots, performance, forced-GC memory, visual quality, or full API/save gate is established. Chrome/Metal and viewport are launch configuration, not retained renderer telemetry.
No broad search exhaustion or optimality claim. R8y/R9j exhausted only the two common positive existing-node/cardinal shortlist entries, leaving this different design class open.
